name: codex-system
description: Mallo shows models, effort and referenced skills for each Codex task, with native progress logs and a readable work summary.

interface.shortDescription: See which models and skills helped with your work
interface.longDescription: Mallo reads native Codex activity, linking each observed task to its model, effort and skill references. Progress stays in native tool logs; a fixed blockquote ends the answer without a separate reporting model.
capabilities: App progress through the Mallo skill
defaultPrompt: Use $mallo to show progress and a final activity summary while doing this task.
